display.title: Pontx Hub Discovery API
display.summary: Pontx's public, unauthenticated discovery API for API products, Endpoints, Schemas, SDK metadata, and published Agent Skills. Account, AI, OAuth token-exchange, and Playground-execution routes are not part of this public API.

documentation.stabilityNote: This product is strictly limited to the read-only discovery and Skill-distribution API published by Pontx Hub. It does not present browser same-origin Playground/OAuth helpers, cookie-based account APIs, the AI Agent API, or internal cron routes as third-party Open APIs.

pricing.summary: The public discovery and Skill-download API currently requires no API key, OAuth token, or paid plan. Callers must still follow the site's reasonable-use expectations and response cache headers.
